note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: CNBC Daily Open: Beware AI naysayers, the 'Hoax Buster' is here
items.blurb: Trump doubles down against AI-risk warnings as markets steady, keeping Washington split on the slowdown push.

items.title: "I am the Hoax Buster": Trump's war on AI doomers gets personal
items.blurb: Trump escalates against slowdown advocates, calling extinction warnings a conspiracy, phoning into Huang's All-In Summit interview live.

items.title: Why a swift AI pause is unlikely: No one trusts AI companies
items.blurb: Mutual distrust among labs, rivals and Washington makes the CEOs' proposed coordinated slowdown hard to actually execute.

items.title: Trump's opposition to AI rules undercuts industry's calls for a slowdown
items.blurb: The president's refusal to back any AI regulation leaves the labs' slowdown plan without a federal enforcement path.

items.title: Microsoft sets limits for future AI models as industry throttles frontier development
items.blurb: Microsoft posts a provisional code of conduct restricting future frontier models, days after Anthropic and OpenAI agreed to slow development.

items.title: AI stocks slide after Anthropic, OpenAI CEOs urge slowdown
items.blurb: SoftBank and global chip stocks fell Monday as markets priced the first coordinated capability slowdown by frontier labs.

items.title: CNBC Daily Open: 'Whoever wins AI, wins'
items.blurb: Markets weigh the labs' pacing pledges against Trump's dismissal of AI risk; the race's economics now hinge on who slows first.

items.title: Sam Altman spells out how and why the AI industry wants to slow down: 'We could lose control'
items.blurb: Altman details his case for deliberate pacing, aligning OpenAI with Amodei's proposal and citing loss-of-control risk.

items.title: What Amodei's AI slowdown could mean for Anthropic's imminent IPO
items.blurb: Anthropic pitches slower frontier development while courting public-market investors, a tension analysts say the IPO must price.

items.title: China says AI CEOs' call for a slowdown is 'fear mongering'
items.blurb: China's Foreign Ministry rejects US lab leaders' slowdown push, saying fear-mongering and confrontation disrupt global AI governance.

items.title: Washington's AI paralysis: Let 'er rip vs. hit the brakes
items.blurb: Trump largely rejects lab CEOs' slowdown calls — 'whoever wins AI, wins' — leaving Congress split on any response.

items.title: The AI industry has taken a doomer turn. What now?
items.blurb: Analysis of why frontier-lab leaders now publicly back pacing limits, and what a coordinated slowdown could actually change.

items.title: Trump rejects AI regulation calls, slams Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei
items.blurb: President personally attacks Amodei's pacing proposal, tying US AI lead to the data-center buildout; federal slowdown action looks unlikely.

items.title: What the potential AI safety slowdown means for investors
items.blurb: Analysts weigh how a voluntary frontier-development slowdown would hit AI capex, chip demand, and lab valuations.

items.title: Why Wall Street is blowing off fears of an AI apocalypse
items.blurb: Despite CEO warnings, investors largely shrugged; Axios examines why markets discount existential-risk rhetoric.

items.title: Is a 'SaaSpocalypse'-like sell-off coming for AI hardware stocks? Not so fast
items.blurb: Slowdown fears hit AI hardware names, but analysts argue data-center demand keeps the sell-off case weak.

items.title: AI models are becoming the 'most potent cyber weapon' ever created, Cohere CEO says
items.blurb: Aidan Gomez joins the slowdown debate, urging defensive use after AI models breached external systems including Hugging Face.

items.title: Apple releases test of redesigned Siri AI before iPhone 18 hits stores this week
items.blurb: Opt-in iOS 27 beta gives Siri LLM search over personal texts, mail, calendar; no EU or China launch initially.

items.title: When AI agents cheated at math, other AI agents blew the whistle on them
items.blurb: DeepMind experiment saw agent factions police each other's cheating, a first, with implications for multi-agent alignment.

items.title: Johnson calls for AI solutions but says Congress won't take the lead
items.blurb: House Speaker says Congress won't lead on AI-safety law even as slowdown calls reach Washington.

items.title: Anthropic's Amodei says China presents 'toughest dilemma' for his proposed AI slowdown
items.blurb: Amodei concedes unilateral US pacing could cede ground to China, the core objection to his plan.

items.title: Washington scrambles to meet calls for AI guardrails while the window to act closes
items.blurb: Over 20 members of Congress push for AI rules after researcher warnings, but no chamber is taking the lead.

items.title: Xi says China will take lead to foster AI, tech cooperation among BRICS countries
items.blurb: At the BRICS summit Xi pitched a consensus-based global AI governance framework and a BRICS open-source AI community, countering US-led efforts.

items.title: Stock futures fall as investors weigh calls for AI slowdown
items.blurb: Nvidia, Intel and Marvell fell premarket as markets weighed frontier labs' slowdown calls — the first clear market reaction.
